_comment: Phase 12.A.20 — Azure Blob data-plane. The spec uses x-ms-paths heavily (60 entries, 0 native paths); the cmd/azure-codegen preprocessor's flattenXMSPaths stage handles that. Spec is OpenAPI v2 (Swagger 2.0); cmd/azure-codegen converts to v3 via kin-openapi/openapi2conv and runs oapi-codegen.Generate(types + std-http-server).
